description:
Once every call site classifies failures by type, the `ErrorCode` variants that only fallback sites produced are dead vocabulary and are removed.

## Background

`ErrorCode` in `crates/jit/src/output.rs` declares codes that existed only so a call site could substitute them: candidates include `GateCheckError`, `GateError`, `DependencyError`, `PresetError`, the `Claim*Error` family, the `Worktree*Error` family, `ItemCommandFailed`, `InvariantCommandFailed`, `ProjectCommandFailed`, `HooksInstallError`, `SearchFailed`, `RecoveryFailed` and `ProfileError`. With command groups moved to library handlers whose failures go through `jit::output::failure::classify`, a code is live only if some error type classifies to it or a findings outcome registers it. Dead codes still appear in `ErrorCode::ALL`, the generated `docs/reference/error-codes.md` (from `scripts/generate-error-code-reference.sh`), the schema's error-code vocabulary, and the expectations in `crates/jit/tests/cli_issue/failure_lever_registry.toml`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every remaining `ErrorCode` variant is returned by `classify` for some error type or registered by some findings outcome; no variant exists only for call-site substitution.
- [hard] REQ-02: No production code constructs a `JsonError` or exit code from a code chosen at the call site.
- [hard] REQ-03: `docs/reference/error-codes.md` and `docs/reference/exit-codes.md` are regenerated from the reduced vocabulary, and the failure-lever registry names only live codes.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each command whose observable code or exit status changes has a test stating the new code and status, and the failure-probe census and envelope contract suites pass without weakened assertions.

## Decisions

- D-01: The retired codes include the five variants nothing constructs (InvalidState, InvariantCommandFailed, WorktreeInfoError, WorktreeListError, WorktreeStoreDivergenceError) and the gate-command fallback codes once the gate handler moves land (steward ruling, 2026-11-04, net-reduction plan D-52).

## Notes

The candidate list is from the investigation; the deciding evidence is the code at the time of the work. Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`.
title: Retire error codes that nothing produces
